verdict.rationale: Auth0 FGA is a first-party, relationship-based authorization platform for multi-tenant B2B APIs and apps that decouples authorization logic from code (auth0-docs-62). It also enforces document-level access control, including in RAG pipelines (auth0-docs-19, auth0-docs-42), which goes beyond the role-based model in auth0-docs-45. The evidence is mostly marketing-level, though: missing for 10: detailed docs on the FGA modeling language and per-resource checks, evidence of policy- or attribute-based conditions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
